messages:
Anya: RFC follow-up: 'Shard Slimdown' — goal is to break the large enrichment cache into tenant-local logical shards and introduce a Cache Control service. Primary intent: reduce noisy-neighbor p99 spikes and make eviction policies explicit per-tenant. Looking for ops/infra runbook and acceptance gates.

Bodi: quick clarifying q: are we changing key formats?

Anya: no. keys unchanged; we add tenant prefix at routing layer. migration will be read-mirror then promote writes.

Samir: ops checklist suggestion: start with mirror-only, backfill hot keys, flip reads for 5 low-risk tenants, validate 48h, then expand. automated rollback triggers for p99 > 1.5x baseline.

Bodi: add chaos test (inject 200-400ms latency into shard service) to ensure upstream fallbacks work.

Anya: agreed. also adding cache-proxy feature-flag so we can toggle where state lives during cutover.

ops-bot: rfc-notify: PR updated https://redwood.internal/rfcs/PR-721 (Anya).

Samir: cost note: sticky-per-tenant shards for top-40 tenants estimated +18% mem; pooled shards +6%. I'll produce a small delta.

Anya: acceptance gates (draft):
- cohort p95 increase <= 7%
- cohort cache hit-rate >= 70% after warm
- dual-write window <= 14d (target 7d)

Bodi: add trace mapping guide for old->new span ids so SRE debugging is straightforward.

Anya: will add dashboards (hit-rate, miss-cost, write-lag, p95/p99). thanks all, will update RFC with runbook & rollback automation.
